name: Epaphras
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament

points: As ye also learned of Epaphras, our dear fellowservant, who is for you a faithful minister of Christ. The church at Colosse heard and learned through Epaphras. That is how they woke up. This brother heard it and said, I am going to teach all of y'all. That is just like today: somebody sees IUIC on the internet, prints out the flyers, starts hitting the city, and then this school pops up and that school pops up. We are the continuation of the acts of the apostles. When we read these scriptures we have to put ourselves in them and envision how the forefathers were, because we are doing the exact same thing.

note.label: The Colossians & The CHRISTIANS of America
